newsitem.title: USA: Coopers & Lybrand 1996 worldwide fee income rises. [CORRECTED 19:11 GMT 18/12]
newsitem.headline: Coopers & Lybrand 1996 worldwide fee income rises. [CORRECTED 19:11 GMT 18/12]

text.p: Coopers & Lybrand International said on Tuesday its worldwide fee income for the year ended September 30 was $6.8 billion, a nine percent increase over last year.
As previously announced, the firm also said it had fiscal 1996 U.S. revenues of $2.1 billion, an 11.1 percent increase over the prior year.

The company said it had solid growth across all its major markets, notably North America, and continued expansion in Asia in line with the firm's strategy of extending its global coverage and achieving critical mass in priority markets.
Coopers & Lybrands said globally, human resources advisory business and management consultancy both grew by 14 percent and tax and corporate finance grew by 12 percent.
